Blaze''' is a [[support gem]] that causes [[melee]] [[attack]]s to have an increased chance to [[ignite]] and for each Ignite inflicted with the Skill recently, it deals less Damage but more Ignite Damage. ==Skill functions and interactions== [[File:Controlled Blaze graph.png|thumb|400px|Graph of a level 20 Controlled Blaze Support's effective multiplier per number of stacks.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/15rb2ej/controlled_blaze_support_math/]] Controlled Blaze will count all hits that have applied ignite, for each monster that received an ignite and any ignite that has been re-applied to an already ignited enemy. Due to the fact that [[more]] and less modifiers are multiplicative, Controlled Blaze will provide less DPS at high number of ignites applied [[recently]]. Depending on the gem level, the number of ignites you need to inflict to reach its highest damage bonus is 12 or 13.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/15rbcvq/optimal_aps_for_controlled_blaze/ This results in a "sweet spot" of 3 to 3.25 attacks per second (assuming no other targets); however, it is better to exceed this value to account for time not spent attacking while dodging/repositioning. That said, in general, you can be about 4 ignites off from the optimal range before you start experiencing a >5% ignite DPS loss. {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" ! Gem level range !
